solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old blower regularly blowing it?

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word blower, starting with its first

parts.note: the word blower supplies its first, third and fifth letters

explanation.surface: A puzzled look at an elderly wind player who keeps blowing on something.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: old plus every other letter of blower builds the word, and the whole is a description of a reed instrument you blow.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe is a woodwind instrument played by blowing through a double reed, so it is the thing being blown.

clue.text: Section of tract: "USA Hopes Go Astray

indicators.note: going astray means wandering off course, so the letters of these three words are rearranged

parts.note: these three words are the letters to be rearranged, taken as written

explanation.surface: A headline-style quote about American hopes going wrong, presented as a section of a political tract.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tract' suggests a pamphlet, but here it is the digestive tract.
explanation.definitionFit: The oesophagus is the gullet, the part of the digestive tract running from throat to stomach.

clue.text: Rebellious daughter visiting loves plant

indicators.note: a visitor goes in, so the daughter's name sits inside the pair of loves

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, written O; two of them give OO
Regan is one of King Lear's two disloyal daughters in Shakespeare

explanation.surface: A wayward daughter drops in on the people she loves, as a houseplant looks on.
explanation.walkthrough: Regan, with Goneril, turns against her father in King Lear.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is an aromatic herb of the mint family, a plant used widely in cooking.

clue.text: Hawkish sarge gives ground

indicators.note: ground as in milled or crushed, so the letters of these two words are broken up and remade

parts.note: the two words are the letters to be rearranged, taken as written

explanation.surface: A warlike sergeant backs down and concedes territory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gives ground' reads as retreating, which fights against 'Hawkish'; 'ground' is really the past tense of grind.
explanation.definitionFit: A hawk in politics favours force, so hawkish means combative and ready for confrontation.

clue.text: Info on cryptic FT clue: "Take the knee"

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: cryptic means puzzling or obscured, so the letters of the two words are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Background on a crossword clue from the Financial Times whose answer is the gesture of kneeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gen' is British slang for information. In a down clue 'on' places the first part above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: To genuflect is to bend one knee to the ground, as in worship or a gesture of respect.

clue.text: Old magistrate one's often seen with ruff

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a local official in medieval England, like a sheriff
second meaning: the female of the ruff, a wading bird

explanation.walkthrough: The ruff looks like the frilled collar an old official might wear, but it is a bird, and the reeve is its mate.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a medieval English local officer and the female of a sandpiper species whose male is the ruff.

clue.text: Deputy cleaner cutting Frenchman's cost of upkeep

indicators.note: cutting into means going inside, so the deputy and cleaner sit within the French name

parts.note: Serge is a typical French man's name
vice as in vice-president, a deputy
a char is a British cleaning lady, short for charwoman

explanation.surface: An assistant cleaner undercuts a Frenchman's price for maintenance work.
explanation.walkthrough: A char, or charwoman, is a British word for a woman paid to clean houses.
explanation.definitionFit: A service charge is a fee paid by tenants or diners towards the running and maintenance costs.

clue.text: Understanding popular view

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a sight is something seen, a view

explanation.surface: An observation that a widely held view reflects real comprehension.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is a deep, intuitive grasp of something, a synonym for understanding.

clue.text: Scrap upcoming motorway test

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to axe a plan is to scrap it

explanation.surface: Abandoning a test on the motorway that was coming up.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam is a formal test of knowledge or skill, short for examination.

clue.text: Mark to remain with lad for Top Gear

parts.note: stet is the proofreader's mark meaning let the deleted text stand
a son is a lad

explanation.surface: A note that a boy will remain as the presenter of the TV motoring show Top Gear.
explanation.walkthrough: Top Gear is a BBC motoring programme, but here it means gear for the top, the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stetson is a broad-brimmed cowboy hat, headwear and so literally a piece of top gear.

clue.text: Arboriculturist may cherish this security service

definitions.meaning: first meaning, playful: a tree specialist would value an exceptional limb of a tree
second meaning: the police unit handling national security

explanation.walkthrough: The first half is whimsical: an expert in trees would treasure a remarkable bough. Special Branch is the British police department dealing with terrorism and state security.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a British police intelligence unit and, read literally, an outstanding bough that a tree specialist would prize.

clue.text: Area is ploughed around university, a vast expanse

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go around the single letter for university
ploughed land is turned over and broken up, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the two words are the letters to be rearranged, taken as written

explanation.surface: A tract of land is ploughed near a campus, opening up a huge open space.
explanation.definitionFit: Eurasia is the combined landmass of Europe and Asia, the largest continental expanse on Earth.

clue.text: Before each church collection Penny's given olive branch

indicators.note: before means this piece comes first, ahead of the rest

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for a penny; the 's is just a link
CE is the Church of England
the offering is the money collected in a church service

explanation.surface: Penny contributes to the church collection plate as a gesture of reconciliation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a woman's name, but it is just P for penny.
explanation.definitionFit: Offering an olive branch is a symbolic gesture of reconciliation, which is exactly what a peace offering is.

clue.text: Make clear cross can straddle large drive

indicators.note: to straddle is to have a leg on either side, so the angry word is split around the others

parts.note: cross as an adjective means angry, irate
a drive can be a strong urge, as is lust

explanation.surface: An instruction to explain whether a crucifix can be placed astride a long driveway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like a noun or verb, but it is the adjective meaning angry.
explanation.definitionFit: To illustrate a point is to explain it with examples, making it clear to the listener.

clue.text: Mayo boxer can go about one round

indicators.note: the boxer's name can go around the others, enclosing them

parts.note: Muhammad Ali, the boxer
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A boxer from County Mayo is able to fight another round.
explanation.walkthrough: Mayo looks like the Irish county, but it is short for mayonnaise.
explanation.definitionFit: Aioli is a garlic mayonnaise from Provence, so it is a kind of mayo.

clue.text: The Spanish cheese lacks minute essential

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the

indicators.note: lacks means one letter is missing from the cheese

parts.note: Emmental is a Swiss cheese with holes

explanation.surface: A Spanish cheese missing one tiny but essential ingredient.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemental describes something basic or fundamental, the same sense as essential.

clue.text: Adorning prominent feature to fill in Parisian gear

parts.note: en is French for in

indicators.note: to fill means to go inside, so the feature is placed within the gear

parts.note: rig is equipment or gear
the chin sticks out from the face

explanation.surface: A fashion note about decorating Parisian clothing with a bold detail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gear' suggests clothes in Paris, but it is rig, equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Enriching can mean embellishing or making more ornate, a sense close to adorning.

clue.text: Make comfy quiet head office in province

indicators.note: the quiet and head office letters go inside the province

parts.note: Ulster is one of the four provinces of Ireland
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A firm sets up a comfortable, quiet headquarters in Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: HO is the common abbreviation for head office.
explanation.definitionFit: To upholster furniture is to pad and cover it, which makes it soft and comfortable.

clue.text: Madrid gent covered up an attempt to steal litres

parts.note: hid means concealed

indicators.note: stealing takes something in, so the litres letter goes inside

parts.note: a go is an attempt

explanation.surface: A Spanish gentleman tries to cover up his theft of some liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidalgo is a member of the Spanish lower nobility, a Spanish gentleman.

clue.text: Indian contribution to growth industry

indicators.note: a contribution is a part given, so the answer is a part of the letters in these words

parts.note: the answer runs across the end of growth and the start of industry

explanation.surface: An Indian businessman's part in an expanding sector.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu is a follower of Hinduism, the majority religion of India, so commonly an Indian.

clue.text: Forbidding sign a reason for calling off contest

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a road sign prohibiting access

definitions.text: a reason for calling off contest
definitions.meaning: second meaning: a competition with zero entrants would be cancelled

explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the phrase literally: if nobody enters, the competition cannot go ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a prohibition sign barring access and a literal lack of competitors that would scrap a competition.

clue.text: Guide present source of power

parts.note: to direct is to guide
current means present, existing now

explanation.surface: An instruction to steer a gift toward an energy supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Direct current is electricity flowing one way, as from a battery, a form of electrical supply.

clue.text: Discern contract snag

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to ... a sound is to make it out
second meaning: to ... an illness is to contract it

explanation.walkthrough: Three separate meanings are run together so they read like a legal note about a problem in an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers perceiving a sound, picking up a disease, and a hidden drawback in a deal.

clue.text: Belligerent seabird smaller ones upset

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so in a down clue the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: auks are seabirds; the little auk and puffin are smaller than this predator

explanation.surface: An aggressive seabird sends the smaller birds flying.
explanation.definitionFit: The skua is a large seabird known for attacking other birds to steal their catch.

clue.text: Caffeine supplier left fish around on floor

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the knockout piece comes first

parts.note: to floor an opponent is to knock them down; KO is a knockout

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the fish is written backwards

parts.note: a tuna is a large sea fish

explanation.surface: Someone supplying coffee left a fish lying on the floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Floor' looks like a noun, but it is the verb meaning to knock down.
explanation.definitionFit: The kola nut is the seed of an African tree, rich in caffeine and once used to flavour cola drinks.

clue.text: I retain distressed sloth

indicators.note: distressed means upset or disordered, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: the two words are the letters to be rearranged, taken as written

explanation.surface: An upset confession of holding on to laziness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sloth' suggests the animal, but it is laziness.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is a tendency to do nothing or stay unchanged, close to sloth as idleness.

clue.text: "Go into a hotel" — the general manager's byword?

indicators.note: into means the going piece sits inside a and hotel

parts.note: taken as written
Hotel is H in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to pop somewhere is to go there briefly
taken as written
GM is the usual abbreviation for general manager

explanation.surface: A hotel manager's motto, apparently urging guests to check in.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'byword' is used loosely for a pithy saying.
explanation.definitionFit: An apophthegm is a concise, pointed maxim, much like a proverb or catchphrase.

clue.text: Class try unoccupied gym

indicators.note: unoccupied means emptied, so only the outer letters of try remain

parts.note: only the outside letters of try are kept, its middle emptied out
PE, physical education, is the school gym lesson

explanation.surface: A school timetable note: try the empty gym for the lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Class' sounds like a school lesson, suiting gym, but it means a sort or kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A type is a category or kind, the same as a class of things.
